lines.2: 「Yeah! I came all this way for you!」
lines.3: 「It's hot as hell out here, so I'm thirsty!」
lines.4: 「We have cold barley tea available. Would you like some?」
lines.7: 「And here is your pamphlet for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival. Please take your time and enjoy yourselves.」
lines.12: I picked it up and handed it back to her.
lines.20: 「Ha ha ha. You do enjoy your jokes.」
lines.21: 「Now then, allow me to show you to the grounds.」
lines.22: 「Forget that. I came a long way, so I'm tired.」
lines.23: 「Tsushima or whatever, kneel down right there!」
lines.25: 「A chair! Be my chair! I'll sit on you!!」
lines.27: 「Ow! Ow! What the hell was that!? You hit a customer!?」
lines.28: 「Throwing out abusive customers is part of our job too!」
lines.30: 「Tsushima, a customer that bad can indeed be asked to leave.」
lines.32: 「Ugh... She pissed me off and I just...」
lines.33: 「You've still got a long way to go.」
lines.34: 「Why don't you show him how it's done, since you're the one giving Tsushima-kun orders?」
lines.36: 「A demonstration, huh. Sato-san, could you play the customer?」
lines.38: 「Even if it's only acting, you're lucky to get the chance to serve me.」
lines.44: 「Isn't this maid's chest kind of big?」
lines.45: 「D-damn it! ...You had to go after something I'm sensitive about.」
lines.48: 「And you're out! There, your real self came through.」
lines.50: 「If the boss is like that, can't really blame Leo for not getting it right.」
lines.51: 「Quite right. Is this all the drama club can manage?」
lines.52: 「Wash your face and come back when you're ready! Aaaahahaha!」
lines.53: The executive committee left behind one incredibly irritating laugh as they walked away.
lines.54: 「Ghh... Damn it, what is WRONG with those people!?」
lines.55: 「Those guys live in a different dimension. Better not let it get to you.」
lines.56: 「Um... Could I take a picture with you...? Hah... hah...」
lines.58: 「Eek! What kind of maid treats people like that!?」
lines.60: In the end, we spent the whole day training.
